name: Barter Herbs: sacrifice up to two Herbs, summon chosen replacement tokens
notes: Barter Herbs (NORM, reserve 1) sacrifices up to two Herb-subtype objects, choosing a replacement Herb token for each one sacrificed (BarterHerbsSacrificeLoop, PotionLogic.php ~664). Two Blightroot HERB tokens are seeded onto the field to sacrifice; each is replaced with Manaroot chosen from the six-option temp-zone menu -- the newly-summoned replacement can land at the same field index as the object just sacrificed (reindexing), so the second sacrifice cycle may target the freshly-summoned token rather than the original second Blightroot; either way the same sacrifice/summon mechanic runs twice, confirmed by both final field objects being Manaroot. Only the base sacrifice/summon loop is covered; the [Class Bonus] Floating Memory clause is a passive/reusable-elsewhere property and out of scope. An ambient opportunity offering the seeded Blightroots' own fast Sacrifice ability appears first and must be declined -- a different mechanic than Barter Herbs' own loop.

rulesClauses: Sacrifice up to two Herbs. For each Herb sacrificed this way, summon your choice of Blightroot, Manaroot, Silvershine, Fraysia, Razorvine, or Springleaf token.
